capabilities: Convert short or long written Bible references to JW Library links
Open Bible texts directly in JW Library without altering the note
Format link output with capitalization, bold/italic, and prefix/suffix options
Choose Bible edition (nwt or nwtsty) and interface language
extras: README lists a roadmap (better text recognition, WOL link support, more languages) and notes Restricted mode must be turned off.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn written-out Bible references into links that open directly in JW Library.

relations.evidence: generate links to JW Library from Bible texts in your notes

summary: Bible reference linker that converts written Bible texts in notes into links that open in JW Library.
